# netbox_rack_role (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/rackrole/):

> Each rack can optionally be assigned a user-defined functional role. For example, you might designate a rack for compute or storage resources, or to house colocated customer devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_rack_role" "test" {
  name      = "test"
  color_hex = "111111"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color_hex` (String) The color hex of the rack role.
- `name` (String) The name of the rack role.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the rack role. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the rack role.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the rack role. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the rack role.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the rack role was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the rack role was last changed.
- `rack_count` (Number) The number of rack objects that refer to the rack role.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_rack_role.example 1
```
